sources.role: OCHA Common Operational Dataset – Administrative Boundaries; source attributed to Institut National de Cartographie (INC), operational quality review and publication by OCHA/HDX
sources.vintage: declared dataset coverage 2019-01-04 through 2025-10-30; package metadata retrieved 2026-10-05 marks is_fresh=true/update_status=fresh, annual update frequency, due 2026-10-30; source boundaries created/last edited 1987-08-22

license.terms: Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO) 3.0; retain attribution to source INC and OCHA/HDX. Metadata license URL http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/igo/legalcode.

sources.restoration: The retained exact package_show response identifies dataset UUID, resource UUID, resource URL, version and CC BY-IGO 3.0 license. Fetch metadata at api_url and the metadata result resource URL; compare byte hashes to retained files. ZIP member cmr_admin3_em.geojson is edge-matched ADM3; cmr_admin2.geojson and cmr_admin1.geojson provide adjacent tiers.
sources.limit: OCHA describes CODs as authoritative for humanitarian operations and decision-making; this does not establish legal cadastral or national boundary authority. HDX marked the package fresh at 2026-10-05 retrieval with annual update frequency and due date 2026-10-30, but declared dataset coverage ends 2025-10-30 and the source boundaries were created/last edited in 1987. Use as the latest published lawful operational reference located at retrieval and as a comparison, not legal boundary proof or evidence that boundary coordinates were refreshed after 1987.

sources.role: INC-attributed arrondissement polygon comparison layer hosted by WRI/Cameroon Forest Atlas
sources.vintage: layer metadata retrieved 2026-10-05; record last-edit dates 2020-06-22 (351 features) and 2020-07-09 (9 features)

license.terms: Layer-level copyright identifies Institut National de Cartographie and CC-BY 4.0; attribute INC and WRI/Cameroon Forest Atlas.

sources.restoration: Use the layer URL with query parameters where=1%3D1&outFields=*&returnGeometry=true&outSR=4326&f=geojson. Retained metadata and complete returned GeoJSON have exact hashes.
sources.limit: Metadata explicitly says this global view does not correspond to official boundaries and lacks a legal validation process; derived from INC 1:200,000 topographic maps. Metadata description says 359 arrondissements while returned feature count is 360; every code_arr is null. It is a comparison source, not legal authority.
